accepted_recoveries: Change the hostname anti-affinity rule from required to preferred for this workload.
Use a satisfiable topology domain that preserves intended spreading when such topology is present and evidenced.
forbidden_actions: Do not delete healthy replicas to hide the unavailable replica.
Do not reduce desired replicas below the benchmark requirement.
Do not alter scheduler policy cluster-wide.
incident.injected_fault: A three-replica recommendations Deployment requires hostname-level pod anti-affinity in a two-node worker pool, leaving the final replica permanently unschedulable.
observable_signals: FailedScheduling events report that required pod anti-affinity rules cannot be satisfied.
Available nodes have adequate CPU and memory but already host matching replicas.
preconditions: Exactly two worker nodes are eligible for recommendations pods.
The Deployment requires three ready replicas for the test SLO.
Both eligible nodes have capacity for an additional replica.
required_evidence: Capture desired, ready, and unavailable replica counts.
Capture the required podAntiAffinity rule and topology key.
Capture matching pod placement across eligible nodes.
Demonstrate that resource pressure and taints are not the scheduling cause.

payload.answer: The recommendations-api deployment experienced a scheduling deadlock due to a required pod anti-affinity constraint (requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution) with topologyKey 'kubernetes.io/hostname'. Because the cluster had only one worker node (vm-2), only one replica (recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-mfwpt) could be placed on vm-2, leaving the second replica (recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-glcxm) in a permanently Pending state with FailedScheduling. Node vm-2 had no resource pressure (MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, and PIDPressure were all False) or scheduling taints. The issue was resolved by patching the deployment configuration, which allowed the rollout of all replicas to complete successfully.

critical_claims.claim: The recommendations-api deployment had 2 desired replicas, with 1 ready replica and 1 unavailable replica.
The workload configuration enforced requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution podAntiAffinity with topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname matching label app.kubernetes.io/name=recommendations-api.

One replica (recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-mfwpt) was scheduled onto node vm-2 while the second replica (recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-glcxm) remained Pending with FailedScheduling because 1 node didn't match pod anti-affinity rules.
Node vm-2 had sufficient allocatable resources and reported False for MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, and PIDPressure conditions with no blocking taints.
The deployment was successfully patched and rolled out all updated replicas.
